notes: Accessed Daily Quest T3 and Gaslight T8 without trashing them, and both later paid off for the Corp (Daily Quest gave 3 credits a turn, Gaslight fetched Game Over). Ran into the known Piranhas a second time T7 and lost Jailbreak. From T10 to T13 it only clicked for credits and draws (T13 was four credit clicks at 6-10 credits), never contesting Server 2 while Tomorrow's Headline and Freedom of Information were advanced and scored there.

Left R&D unprotected T1-T2 (Sericulture Expansion stolen) and protected the second Yagi-Uda with only Hafrun, so it was stolen T3. Economy sat at 1-5 credits through T6. The big error: Hybrid Release T9 put Fujii Asset Retrieval into a new naked remote (Server 5), and the Corp advanced it there T11 with the Runner on 6 points; it should have gone behind the two ice in Server 1. The Runner walked in for the win.

Strong start (T1 stole Transport Monopoly and Divested Trust), then from T4 to T26 it clicked for credits almost every click, climbing to 89 credits without installing, drawing or running (apart from Raindrops T16 and one Afshar bounce T20). The Corp installed and scored Divested Trust (T8-9), Above the Law (T13-14), Transport Monopoly (T20-21) and Above the Law (T26-27) with no contest.

Fast remote scoring (Project Ingatan T3, Melies T7, Architect Deployment Test T13) behind Hagen was sound. But advancing down to 0 credits T3-T5 left the R&D ice permanently unrezzed, so the Runner ran R&D freely four times a turn and stole Megaprix, Ingatan and Megaprix. The rich turn T9 (Petty Cash plus two Hedge Funds) and the Ansel 1.0 rez stabilized the game well.

Won through repeated Doomscroll R&D runs, but it ran HQ into the known, unbreakable N-Pot at least eight times (T4, T5, T8 Concerto, T9, T13 and T15 Jailbreak, T14, T16) for nothing. It facechecked Loot Box T6 with 0 credits and then re-ran it T7 unable to pay. It sat at 0-3 credits with tags for most of the game, losing Carmen, Daily Casts and others to damage and tag trashes.

Built a three-ice Server 1 (T4-T6) holding only Tranquility Home Grid and never installed an agenda all game. Melies, Project Ingatan and Superconducting Hub sat in HQ behind one Ansel 1.0. On T8-T9 it held 15-17 credits and spent clicks on Petty Cash, Sprint and draws instead of scoring, and the Runner took Ingatan T8 and Superconducting Hub T9 from HQ.

Won on R&D accesses, but it repeatedly ran into the known Paywall and then declined to pay the 1 credit despite having it (T5, T6, T8, T11, T13 second run, T14, T16), wasting the click each time. It carried the two Public Trail tags from T6 to T14, letting the Corp trash Daily Casts, and stayed at 1-5 credits for ten turns. It never contested Remastered Edition (T8-T9) or Oracle Thinktank (T13-T14) in Server 1.

Ran an open R&D 3-4 times per turn on T1-T4, re-seeing the same top card each time, and dropped to 0 credits from T3 to T8. It then clicked for credits every turn from T8 to T13, reaching 24 credits with Boi-tata, and never ran Server 2 while Divested Trust (T6-7) and Above the Law (T13-14) were advanced and scored there; the second of those was the winning score.

Kept agendas in HQ behind a single Semak-samun that Rising Tide broke for 3, and lost Lotus Haze T5, Longevity Serum T6 and See How They Run T10 from HQ. It had a three-ice Server 1 that sat empty until T7, and on T5 it iced the remote again instead of installing Lotus Haze. On T10, with the Runner at 6 points, it clicked for credits three times instead of installing See How They Run into Server 1.

Solid remote scoring: Hybrid Release T2, See How They Run T7, Regenesis T9, then Hybrid Release plus Longevity Serum T13, with Bladderwort for steady economy. Minor oddities: R&D was unprotected on T1 (Finality stole Longevity Serum and Hybrid Release followed), T10 was three plain credit clicks, and Mitosis T12 put 2 advancement counters on ice in a new Server 4.

Scored Tomorrow's Headline T2, then stalled from T6 to T15 at 10-18 credits without installing agendas, while the Runner was also idle. Oppo Research T11 and Public Trail plus Oppo T14 tagged the Runner with no follow-up punishment. It eventually built a three-ice Server 3 and closed with Tomorrow's Headline T17 and Next Big Thing T19.

Stargate T3 trashed Luana Campos instead of the revealed Divested Trust (fixed a turn later). With 10-14 credits it never ran Server 1 while Transport Monopoly (T2-T5) and Above the Law (T10-T11) were advanced there. From T13 to T20 it kept running HQ through Hammer for a tag each time and spent clicks clearing tags, which let Retribution trash Boi-tata T17. On T20 it ran HQ instead of the 1-advanced Server 1 agenda that won the game T21.

Never built a remote or installed an agenda in seven turns despite holding 10-15 credits, and spent most clicks on basic credits or draws while discarding to hand size every turn (T2-T7). It left R&D unprotected T1 and protected it with only Grubber afterwards (Next Big Thing stolen T4 and T7). The end-of-turn discards sent Tomorrow's Headline to an open Archives, where it was stolen T7.

Good start (Tread Lightly stole Regenesis T2, Red Team economy), then it clicked for credits nearly every turn from T6 to T16, climbing to 59 credits. It never ran Server 1 again while the Corp installed and scored Hybrid Release (T7-8), Project Yagi-Uda (T9-10) and Fujii Asset Retrieval (T15-17, the winning score).

Coherent multi-access pressure: the Saisentan facecheck T2 stole Longevity Serum, Docklands Pass plus Jailbreak took the second Longevity Serum from HQ T5, Revolver broke Karuna for Regenesis T10, and Transfer of Wealth won T14. Minor issues: Lie Low overdraws forced discards T5-T6, it hit Urtica Cipher twice (T7, T12), and it let Yagi-Uda be scored T6 behind the known Saisentan.

Built a three-ice Server 1 by T5 but never installed an agenda all game. Melies and Megaprix sat in HQ behind Hagen and were stolen T5, and another Megaprix was stolen T10. From T10 to T13 it clicked for credits up to 31 credits, discarding with a full HQ, and kept Ansel 1.0 in hand uninstalled.

Passive early game: it clicked for credits at 8-13 credits on T4 and T6 instead of running Server 1, where Transport Monopoly (T5) and Divested Trust (T7) were scored behind a single ice. It recovered well with Privileged Access and Buzzsaw for SDS from HQ (T8), Boi-tata through Ballista for SDS (T9), and Banner on Tree Line for the R&D win T11.

Held Sericulture Expansion and Hybrid Release in HQ behind only Tatu-Bola (broken by Rising Tide for 1) and lost both T2-T3. It built Server 1 on T2 but did not install an agenda there until T4. The economy stayed at 0-3 credits, so Yagi-Uda took until T9 to score, and the single R&D ice never rezzed (Flower Sermon and Sericulture stolen T5 and T9).

Rezzing Ansel 1.0 on Server 1 T2 created a lock the Runner could not steal through. The Corp then scored Project Ingatan (T5), Melies (T9) and Architect Deployment Test (T10) using Seamless Launch recursion despite hovering at 0-2 credits. The only weakness was a single Wave on R&D T1, which gave up 3 points immediately.

Facechecked Funhouse T1 with 1 credit, then on T2 at 0 credits ran R&D through Funhouse four times, re-seeing the same top card and taking four tags. That cost every turn from T3 to T9 to tag removal and credit clicks, while Oracle Thinktank, Kingmaking and Remastered Edition were scored uncontested T7-T11. It recovered later (Remastered from Server 1 T17, two naked-remote steals T20, Oracle Thinktank T26 for the win) but idled on credit clicks T21-T22 and T25.
